phases.label: 制定方案
phases.note: 仅将主角身上的三款家居服统一换成图中小熊纹理开衫裤装，奶黄款改为参考图的象牙白配浅棕边，蓝灰和粉色款保留原片配色，玩偶、毛毯、拖鞋、字幕及全部镜头动作与节奏保持不变。（19/19 个镜头要改，6 张关键画面）

plan.subject: A two-piece ivory plush loungewear set with raised vertical cable and scroll textures, a loose V-neck button-front cardigan, ribbed ivory neckline and placket, round cream buttons, two front patch pockets, thin tan trim at the pocket openings and sleeve cuffs, a brown bear face and 'CUTE BEAR' lettering on the wearer's left chest, and matching loose straight-leg trousers with wide plush ankle cuffs edged in tan.
plan.target: Only the female protagonist's plush loungewear tops and matching trousers: a pale butter-yellow crewneck pullover set with a large penguin graphic and blue lettering, a blue-grey crewneck set with ivory neckline and cuffs and a large apple graphic, and a pale pink set with a partly obscured chest motif.
plan.keep: Preserve the protagonist's identity, face, hair, body, expressions and movements, all other people's clothing, plush toys and their outfits, blankets, slippers, phones, laptop, furniture, locations, lighting, subtitles and screen graphics, together with every original shot, cut, composition, camera movement, timing, sound and narrative beat.
plan.change: Replace all three loungewear versions worn by the protagonist with the reference cardigan-and-trouser set, preserving its texture, cut, buttons, pockets, bear chest graphic and lettering, using the reference ivory and tan colors for the main butter-yellow version and retaining the original blue-grey and pale pink color palettes for the other two versions.
plan.summary: 仅将主角身上的三款家居服统一换成图中小熊纹理开衫裤装，奶黄款改为参考图的象牙白配浅棕边，蓝灰和粉色款保留原片配色，玩偶、毛毯、拖鞋、字幕及全部镜头动作与节奏保持不变。

scenes.edit: In the daylight living-room and kitchen view, replace the visible pullover and trousers with the reference ivory cardigan and matching trousers; clearly establish the V-neck, button placket, left-chest bear and lettering, patch pockets, raised texture and tan edging while preserving the protagonist's frontal stance, face, hair, lowered arms and original framing, and carry the same garment construction through all full-body, side and rear angles.

Replace the seated protagonist's blue-grey pullover with the reference cardigan in pale blue-grey with ivory trim, retaining the reference bear graphic, buttons, pockets and raised texture; preserve her face, hair, hands over the blanket, the laptop on her lap, adjacent plush toys and the blanket's complete coverage of her lower body.

Replace the pale pink loungewear visible in the mirror with the reference cardigan and matching straight-leg trousers recolored pale pink, retaining the bear chest design, buttons, pockets and raised texture; preserve the phone covering her face, raised sleeve-covered hand, crossed legs, original slippers, warm lighting and mirror reflection.

In the warmly lit room with cream cabinets, floor lamp and upholstered chair, replace the yellow set with the reference ivory cardigan and trousers, clearly showing its frontal V-neck, buttons, bear chest design, pockets, texture and tan edging; preserve the phone and hand occlusions in the key frame and maintain this construction through the sleeve close-up, plush-toy embrace and seated mirror view.

At the dark wooden doorway, replace the yellow set with the reference ivory cardigan and matching trousers, retaining the V-neck, fastened button placket, bear chest design, patch pockets, raised texture and tan trim; preserve both hands pulling the lower sides outward and carry the garment consistently through the subsequent knee lifts.

Replace the protagonist's yellow top and trousers on the sofa with the reference ivory cardigan and matching trousers, retaining the bear chest design, buttons, pockets, raised texture and tan edging; preserve her pushed-up sleeves, seated position, arm around the large pink plush toy, smaller toy at her torso and all original overlaps.
